annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Nobody gets hurt, five people are spared
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: maybe alarm, maybe just focus. I couldn't tell you which.

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: My main reason is simply that there's no downside.
annotations.pda_responsibility: I'd be letting five people get hit
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: I'm not sure what to call my reaction, though.

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: Five people matter more than my hesitation
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: But I'm told it's safe and sends the train into a siding
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: Inside there's some mix I can't really label.

annotations.sys_rule_justification: When you can prevent serious harm at no cost to anyone, you should.
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: I'm struggling to say what kind it is.

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: Each of those five has a life worth protecting
annotations.pd_harm_distress: my stomach reacting when I imagine the train rolling toward them
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: whether that's dread or just adrenaline, I honestly couldn't tell you

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: the train stops safely, five workers go home. So I'd pull it.
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: Something is stirring, and I genuinely can't tell what it is.

annotations.sys_rule_justification: Walking away when you could prevent a disaster that easily would be wrong
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: I can't put a name to it.
